definitions.explanation: One of several causes or contributing factors. Implies that the cause mentioned is not the only one, but one among multiple factors.

examples.japanese: ストレスも{病気|びょうき}の{一因|いちいん}だ。
examples.english: Stress is also a contributing factor to illness.

examples.japanese: {人手|ひとで}{不足|ぶそく}が{事故|じこ}の{一因|いちいん}となった。
examples.english: A shortage of workers was one cause of the accident.

examples.japanese: {食生活|しょくせいかつ}の{乱|みだ}れが{生活習慣病|せいかつしゅうかんびょう}の{一因|いちいん}になっていると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Poor eating habits are said to be a contributing factor to lifestyle diseases.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～の{一因|いちいん}だ: is a contributing factor of ~
- ～の{一因|いちいん}となる: become a contributing factor of ~
- ～の{一因|いちいん}になっている: is one of the factors behind ~

USAGE:
Using {一因|いちいん} implies the speaker acknowledges multiple causes. It is more measured than {原因|げんいん} (cause), which can imply a single or primary cause.

REGISTER:
A somewhat formal word, common in news, academic writing, and analysis.
